_comment: Pegasus at high realised connectivity. Measured on P16, 12 seeds: the patch size, not the chain length, controls the degree of the induced subgraph on active qubits. patch_sites=96 gives max degree 3.7; patch_sites=24 gives 7.4-10.0 and 2.5x the quotient edges, at the cost of growth jamming more often (target_met 58-67%, reported per record). A 14-qubit sub-instance cannot reproduce the device's mean degree of 14.4 over 5640 qubits - most neighbours lie outside it - so this is the densest honest approximation at simulable size, not a full-device instance.
